note: A task model is a trained policy/skill pack for a specific physical job. Hardware capability is not enough. Do not call these certificates in product UI.
honesty: Chat LLMs (GPT, Claude, Gemini, Llama, Mistral) are not warehouse pick, hospital logistics, or CNC tending policies. Search vision-language-action families and OEM packs. Token API prices are not robot-policy prices.

qualify_filters.label: Is it a robot policy (VLA / OEM pack), not a chat LLM?
qualify_filters.note: OpenVLA, π0.5, Octo, LeRobot, ACT, GR00T N1.5, or an OEM application pack. GPT/Claude/Gemini/Llama text APIs do not pick cases or run hospital linens.

qualify_filters.label: Does the license allow commercial placement?
qualify_filters.note: Research-only and non-commercial CC licenses cannot put a robot into paid work. Check the model card before a distributor quotes a job.

qualify_filters.label: Can it run on this robot, on-prem, or only in the cloud?
qualify_filters.note: On-robot / edge work prefers small or quantized policies (often under ~8B parameters, or an OEM stack). Cloud VLMs are not the cell policy. Physical AI also pays simulation + always-on inference, not one pretrain run.

qualify_filters.label: Does context match the job (site map, video, long SOP)?
qualify_filters.note: Huge context windows matter for long video or documents. A pick cell still needs the motor policy, not a 1M-token chat window.

qualify_filters.label: Has it been qualified on this workplace?
qualify_filters.note: A downloaded checkpoint is not a site-qualified warehouse or hospital policy until that site says so.

pricing_lookups.name: BenchLM LLM pricing
pricing_lookups.note: Pay-per-token / image API list prices. Useful for managed VLMs. Not a price for an OEM warehouse pack or a trained cell policy.

pricing_lookups.name: Axe Compute — physical AI compute stack
pricing_lookups.note: Why robot policies cost more than LLMs: simulation, synthetic data, VLA training, and continuous on-robot inference. Quote GPU hours here — do not invent a dollar figure.

pricing_lookups.name: Vertex AI Model Garden
pricing_lookups.note: Google Gemini plus curated open models, billed per token/image. Not a robot cell license.

pricing_lookups.name: Amazon Bedrock
pricing_lookups.note: Unified API pricing for Claude, Llama, Titan, and others. Filter by use case; still not a warehouse pick policy.

pricing_lookups.name: Azure AI Foundry
pricing_lookups.note: OpenAI frontier models plus enterprise open-source. Pay-per-token. Does not qualify a hospital AMR.

pricing_lookups.name: Databricks Foundation Model APIs
pricing_lookups.note: Hosted FM pay-per-token on Databricks. Orientation for cloud cost, not physical-task pricing.

pricing_lookups.name: OEM application / fleet license quote
pricing_lookups.note: Usually not on a public price list. Ask the OEM what the task pack costs for this SKU.

pricing_lookups.name: Integrator cell / site-program SOW
pricing_lookups.note: Custom training and fixture programs are often the largest line item. Distributors who only resell hardware leave this unpaid.

shared_lookups.name: Foundation models in robotics (Robocloud)
shared_lookups.note: Orientation on robotics foundation models. Not a catalog of site-qualified policies.

shared_lookups.name: Papers with Code — robotics / manipulation
shared_lookups.note: Academic leaderboards mapped to code and weights. Best-on-benchmark ≠ qualified on this workplace.

shared_lookups.name: GitHub — foundation-model codebases

shared_lookups.name: Robotic Data
shared_lookups.note: Real-world Physical AI training data (LiDAR, human/task traces). A dataset is not a site-qualified warehouse or hospital policy. Do not invent a dataset price.

shared_lookups.name: World Labs — real-to-sim-to-real (SceniX)
shared_lookups.note: Train and evaluate robot policies in reconstructed scenes, then transfer back to the physical cell. Simulation success is not workplace qualification.

shared_lookups.name: Mercor
shared_lookups.note: People who can train, fine-tune, or host a robot policy. This is who builds the task model — not SIGNAL buyers and not a price list.
